moves.name:
Precipitous Cliffs
Earth Power
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user’s Sp. Atk is raised.
Deactivation Condition: When the user’s Sp. Atk is not raised.

Never misses. Lowers the target’s Sp. Def by 2 stat ranks. Increases the user’s Special Moves ↑ Next effect by one to four ranks at random. In addition, increases the user’s Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 1 rank when the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.
